```text
This 50% benchmark might strike you as
somewhat arbitrary so let me back it up
with some maths.

We've already met RFE many times
throughout the manual. Recall from
Chapter 2 that RFE pre-flop is far from
an accurate value as there are still three
more potential streets of action should
Villain call our open. This meant that to
steal the blinds, we needed less fold
equity than the RFE calculation
suggested. So when we 3-bet bluff pre-
flop with a hand that has some post-flop
prospects, we need much less fold
equity to print money in a vacuum than
```
